snippet.title: Hotel Architect | Early Access Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Hotel Architect is Out Now in Steam Early Access! 

Launching into Early Access, Hotel Architect features four playable locations, each with their own career and sandbox modes available, multiple staff types to manage, several guest types to impress, numerous zones to design and decorate, and much much more to come! 

Players can experience what it takes to step into the role of a hotel owner today, with Hotel Architect available at a discounted launch price of just £12.79 / $15.99 / €15.99. 

Buy Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1602000/Hotel_Architect/

Follow Hotel Architect:

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hotel_architect_game/
Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@hotel_architect_game
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/hotelarchitect.bsky.social
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/HotelArchitect/
Discord: Discord.gg/HotelArchitect

Twitter/X: https://x.com/WiredP
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/wiredpro/
Discord : https://discord.com/wiredp​
Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/wired_productions/
Bandcamp: https://wiredproductions.bandcamp.com/follow_me
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@wiredp
Wired Store: https://shop.wiredproductions.com/

Launch Trailer:
Created in collaboration with Black Razor Records who have provided the music, the trailer celebrates the launch of Hotel Architect into Early Access.

As with all visual elements, music plays a vital role in deepening the connection between players and the worlds they explore, and few understand this better than Black Razor Records. Known for creating immersive, story-driven songs and soundtracks, their latest collaboration brings the launch trailer for *Hotel Architect* to life.
 
To match the game’s ambitious vision, Black Razor Records delivered a track brimming with energy, forward momentum, and vibrant textures perfectly capturing the spirit of the game and setting the tone for an unforgettable experience.
